topic: Tropical Rainforest, Coral Reef and Mangrove Ecosystems
key_concepts: An ecosystem is an environment where living and non-living things exist and interact.
Living things in a tropical rainforest include plants and animals.
Non-living things in a tropical rainforest include soil, air, humidity, water and sunlight
Tropical rainforests have layers: emergent, canopy, understory and forest floor.
Emergent trees are 130 to 180 feet tall.

Producers such as trees and shrubs provide food for consumers.
Herbivores are plant-eating animals and carnivores are flesh-eating animals.
A food chain starts with a producer followed by consumers and decomposers.
A food web results from interconnected food chains.
